title: A vectorial lattice Boltzmann scheme for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations
summary: We introduce a second-order accurate vectorial lattice Boltzmann scheme for the incompressible Navier-Stokes system, inspired by a discrete-velocity kinetic approximation proposed by Carfora and Natalini [ESAIM: M2AN, 42(1), 93-112, 2008]. Advantages and drawbacks compared to relaxation schemes are investigated by providing spectral analyses in the linearized case, and numerical validations on the genuinely non-linear problem.
